This paper focuses on designing of sequential circuits and reducing the number of constant inputs - CI and the garbage outputs - GO. Basic reversible gates are used to build sequential circuits. D Flip flop, Latch and RAM cell are developed. All circuits are VHDL coded on Xilinx tool, simulated and verified. Reduction in CI of more than 33 percent and GO of more than 80 percent is achieved. This is achieved by properly reusing the outputs for configuring the constant input of other gates.

articleTitle: Smart Ambulance for Traffic Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The effect of traffic congestion has a major impact on the loss of time in an emergency. Smart traffic management systems utilize sensors, GPS, and automation to monitor and direct the traffic inspector to reduce congestion. Nowadays there is a detrimental flaw in traffic management, especially in an emergency. In metropolitan areas, the average distance from an emergency department, is 3.6miles, this distance can be easily covered in mere minutes, but due to heavy traffic congestion, there is always a delay in reaching out to the nearest hospital which leads to increase in death rate. The main objective of this project is to decrease the travelling time of the ambulance. It enriches users with prior information about traffic local convenience real time running information which reduced the travelling time of the commuters and enhances the survival rate. Implementation, the app is going to be used by Ambulance drivers and traffic inspectors. Ambulance driver builds his profile by entering his details such as Vehicle Number, name etc., Similarly, the traffic inspector will build his profile by entering the route details in which he's currently working on. In an emergency, a driver needs to select a route in which way he's going to travel to the hospital. And the traffic inspectors in the corresponding route gets an alert and the traffic inspector will be able to track the ambulance location and clear the traffic and make the way for the ambulance accordingly in prior.

articleTitle: Quarcare - IoT Based Patient Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to monitor patient's health using a web application. In an analysis, the data collected from the public hospitals in bigger cities found that many people were facing a issues such as Inadequate reach of Healthcare services, shortage of medicare and also unmanageable patient loads. This paper aims to resolve the above discussed problems by providing several features to patients like online consultation with doctors, emergency ping to a doctor, online appointment scheduling, telemedicine, Videocall Consultation along with Online prescription. For this primarily, the patient's data are monitored using the Temperature sensor and Heartbeat sensor. The measured data are sent to the secure database which provides an alert if the health parameters exceed the threshold. Theoretical and practical implication of the project are discussed.

articleTitle: Mega Bot – The Healthcare Chatbot
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This project aims to help people to check their health condition before going to a hospital this saves a lot of time and value and also allows you to know your symptoms in advance. It can perform tasks related to symptoms same like a doctor who takes a checkup but in a more accurate way. Machine Learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Deep-Learning (DL) and IOT are used to detect the symptoms and checks the temperature. This algorithm using dependencies such as pysklearn, nltk, Tensor Flow, OpenCV, AI, and Raspberry Pi. It usually enters by entering the login details and then it asks you to click the start button and then you can say “yes” or “no” and then it finally uses to suggest the online doctors. There are also way more features like face checkup, fever checkup and third party infermedica API. The face checkup is used to check the emotions and fever is used to detect temperature and then third party infermedica API deals with your symptoms.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Automated Waste Segregation System based on degradability
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Rapidly increasing rate of consumption of resources by the growing population has led to a drastic spike in the amount of waste generated. Due to lack of effective management of waste at the initial stage of waste disposal from domestic as well as industrial sector causes segregation and recycling process to be challenging. A model is suggested in this paper which focuses on the software portion of an automatic waste segregation system where a camera and Raspberry Pi are mounted to detect and classify the individual waste item placed on a conveyor belt that carries the waste to the respective dustbin based on the classification done by Pi module. The software module consists of a Deep Learning algorithm called Single Shot Detector model with MobileNet as base network to classify the waste into biodegradable and non-biodegradable.

articleTitle: Development of Semi-active Hybrid Energy Storage System for e-Bike
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: There are many challenges related to energy storage system (ESS) in electrical applications and one of the major challenges is to balance the energy and power density across the devices to drive electric vehicle at a long run. Basically, Hybrid Energy Storage System (HESS) is preferred with battery in parallel with supercapacitor to balance the energy and power supply to the electric vehicle motor. In order to prolong the life of the battery, supercapacitor is be used in this work to reduce the burden on the energy density device namely battery to drive the vehicle. Therefore, this work aims to develop the Semi-HESS topology to drive electric vehicle (EV), design and development of energy balance between the sources and DC-DC converter to drive the vehicle. The high-energy density device which is the battery and high-power density namely the supercapacitor is assembled as semi-active topology to control the speed of the electric vehicle motor which is BLDC (Brushless DC) motor of 48V, 3000 rpm to run smoothly. The study is carried out under different modes of operation of the e-bike vehicle motor through energy and power balance using DC-DC converter which regulate the power and the speed as per the requirement. Study is simulated and the results are validated using MATLAB/ Simulink.

articleTitle: An advanced approach for Smart Parking Solution Based on Ethereum Block chain System
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the past few years, the use of the internet and mobile applications has rapidly increased. People use them for all of their needs, from online shopping to online bank transactions. With such enormous use, there comes a high risk of this data getting hacked and/or misused. Such attacks are quite common with applications that use a centralized server. Such shortcomings of centralized servers can be overcome by using decentralized networks like the block chain. Through this paper, I propose a solution that would help solve the problem of finding a parking lot for your vehicles. This solution has been created with the use of the Ethereum block chain (a distributed computing platform that is based on blockchain), and with the use of smart contracts. [1] This application is designed to provide an efficient way to further utilize the private parking spaces available in urban cities. It provides both the owners of parking lots and those who are in search of parking lots (in urban areas), a platform where they can exchange these resources. In the application, sellers lease out their parking lots while buyers book the parking lots.

articleTitle: Advanced patient's Heart Rate monitoring system using Cloud based Android system
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Heart related diseases are getting increased in present days. Eating habits of individuals are getting changes which results in cardiovascular diseases at even at the ages of above 35 years. Heartbeat of cardiovascular disease persons who are at high risk has to be monitored continuously. Ups and downs of heartbeat has to be monitored and the readings to be noted down. Hence using cloud computing and IoT, an advanced model is proposed which can have a close watch on individuals who are at risk with heart-related diseases. The continuously obtained heartbeat data of the patient can be helpful as information to the doctors. This system also has an encryption system with AES 128 for ensuring privacy. Here android application-based model is proposed as a bridge for communication of alerts related to hearts and continuous monitoring.

articleTitle: Medication Alerts and Supervisory of Health Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The proposed system helps in measuring body temperature and heart beat through sensors besides reminding the medicines at appropriate time. All these things are carried by the help of Node MCU, sensors, GSM module, Blynk etc. This project renders people by giving timely alerts. The digital world ideas in which distinct sensors and LPU (local processing units) are interconnected for data sharing is implemented in numerous industries during these days. Medical drugs takes part a key role for prohibiting and healing many infections or diseases. Most of the dangerous and high-risk diseases can be healed by taking appropriate medication. The system will give alert to the patient on time for their prescription and comprises of IoT medication reminder system. It will give an alert to the patient to take medicine on time by presenting them audio and visual warn. This project is utilized in the system either that victim has taken prescription and its precautions.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of AODV Routing Protocol for MANET Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Routing in Mobile Ad-hoc Networks (MANETs) has gained gigantic attention due to the mobility of nodes, standalone infrastructure, and lack of a centralized arbitrator. These moving nodes make the routing technique highly complex and unstable within a limited radio range. When the network size increases, the length of the complete path increases, and the header size of data packets also increase which brings the network slowdown in operation. To address these issues, many researchers have explored many Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques to route the data packets from the source to the destination. This paper aims to develop a new routing protocol that exploits the principle of genetic algorithm to find the shortest path from source to the destination. The proposed protocol is experimented through the ns-2 simulator and proves its maximum efficiency over traditional AODV protocol in terms of throughput, average residual energy, and extends the network lifetime at crossover probability 0.5.

articleTitle: Design and Development of E-Vehicle with Phone Control
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A vehicle is commonly described as any mobile equipment that is controlled by a method that does not restrict its movement. This is also known as a radio control device or an IR controller because there is a cable between the controller and the car. A remote control vehicle that, unlike a robot, is always commanded by a person and does not take positive action on its own. Remote vehicle control is one of the most essential technologies in this industry. This paper focuses a e-vehicle capable to drive accurately at a destination location, navigating within that target region and return back to base station accurately and safely. Also, this paper proposes a e-vehicle is designed and its control can be carried out by Arduino via a cell phone.

articleTitle: Wideband SIW Based Self-diplexing Antenna Using Parasitic Slots
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A wideband self-diplexing antenna (SDAN) based on a substrate integrated waveguide (SIWG) is investigated and presented for satellite communications in X-band. TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">120</inf> mode is utilized for self-diplexing operation. For exciting dual frequencies, the SIWG cavity structure is divided into two sub-cavities by utilizing an additional array of metallic vias in the middle of the cavity. Three rectangular slots (one main slot and two parasitic slots) are stacked together and loaded on each SIWG sub-cavity for achieving wide bandwidth. The antenna exhibits a relative impedance bandwidth of 8.1% and 9.1% at 8.7GHz and 10.5GHz, respectively. Strong self-diplexing characteristics are achieved with a minimum 20dB isolation across the entire bandwidth. The broadside radiation characteristics are achieved with low level of cross polarization. The peak realized gain at aforementioned two working frequencies is 5.11dBi and 7dBi. The excellent performance of suggested SDAN makes it a strong choice for multiple frequency transmit and receive operation in X-band.

articleTitle: Using Transfer Learning and Pattern Recognition to Implement a Smart Waste Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Smart cities are nowadays a very growing industry and a way of life that people want to experience. The technology that is used in the smart cities very well provide better living standards for the people. Smart city is most commonly utilised the benefits of information and communication technology. Internet of Things has opened a very vast space and has brought in many opportunities for all kind of research and development to integrate technology into people's life and hence make smart city is possible. this is a very vast topic to discuss as it has many different applications like water leak detection, gas leak detection, street lights that are smart and a very well designed traffic management system. also making use of this technology a very efficient way to collect waste can also be designed to maintain a very healthy lifestyle for the people and also minimizing the operation cost. This research paper presents a very well designed and completely new architecture In order to implement a smart waste management system which at its core implements artificial intelligence technique and machine learning with a combined focus on Internet of Things. By combining this approach with deep learning a system can be made which has a very minimal operation cost while not compromising on performance.

articleTitle: A study on Quality Assessment of Requirement Engineering Document using Text Classification Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The Software Requirement Engineering document is the most important artifacts of the software development life cycle model. In majority of software systems, the Requirements Engineering (RE) Document or SRS (Software Requirement Specification) document has been written in natural language English that are prone to ambiguity. The ambiguous Requirement Engineering document may lead to disastrous results thereby hampering the entire development process and ending up compromising on the quality of a system. The success of any software product depends upon the quality of the Requirement Engineering document. The main reason for software crisis in software Industry is the Ambiguous Requirement Engineering Document. This paper discusses about the types of ambiguity, approaches to handle and providing a level of automatic assistance in order to detect ambiguity in the Requirement Engineering Document. The study also confirms the use of text classification technique to classify a text as “ambiguous” or “Unambiguous” at the syntax level. The key objectives of the work include understanding the presence of ambiguity in any Requirement Engineering document with the help of Machine Learning Techniques and finally minimizing or reducing it.

articleTitle: A Survey On Clustering Algorithms For Cluster-Head Selection in VANET
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: One of the major sectors in wireless networks is the Ad - hoc network. It mainly classified into two categories MANETs (Mobile Ad-hoc Networks) and VANETs (Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks). VANET is the ad-hoc network which having ad-hoc nodes in the form of vehicles which communicate among themselves. Combining vehicles and the Roadside Unit (RSU) constitutes a network. VANET has become a major field of research in the improvement of safety of vehicles and the roads, efficiency of the traffic, and also to increase the comfort to both drivers and passengers. VANETs differ a lot from MANETs because of the fact that VANETs include highly mobile vehicles, which causes many challenges in designing a VANET network. Different Clustering techniques are used to overcome this challenges and it can be done by grouping the vehicles but not all methods are enough to compile all the issues so we need to do a review on different clustering techniques. Cluster designs focus primarily on the design of stable clusters and the decision of members of the cluster, which is done by using one or more members from within the cluster as the head of that cluster. But the selection of CH (Cluster Head) is the most critical issue. The clustering algorithms that are being made use of in VANETs have been discussed in various research studies. In this article, we will be discussing the literature related to the different cluster head selection algorithms that are being used for VANETs and will talk about its challenges and issues. In addition, the proposed technique is assessed and compared to existing techniques according to the parameters.

articleTitle: Review of Fault Tolerant Power Converters Deployed In Critical Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Fault tolerant system design is of high importance in today's emerging era. Aircraft control, medical applications, automobiles, security services and other critical applications demand high degree of fault tolerance. Fault tolerant power supplies form an important sub system of all critical applications. This paper makes an attempt to understand different fault tolerant power systems and ways of achieving fault tolerance in different power converters.

articleTitle: Classification of Foot Thermograms using Texture Features and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Foot ulcers in Diabetic Mellitus patients are a serious concern as they could lead to amputation of the foot if not detected at early stages. Routine monitoring of the foot using reliable diagnostic tools is essential to assess the risk of developing the ulcer. As ulcers exhibit high vascularity in ulcer-affected areas in the foot, this temperature can be captured and analyzed using image processing techniques. In this paper, 50-foot thermograms are considered for the study. The grey level texture features are calculated in the form of a matrix from the intensity values of normal and diabetic foot thermogram, and they are given as input vectors to the support vector machine classifier. The study performed well in classification and resulted in 96.42 % of accuracy.

articleTitle: Flexible Broadband Dielectric Resonator Antenna for Wearable Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A flexible broadband Dielectric Resonator Antenna (DRA) for wearable applications is proposed in this work. The microstrip feed line Dielectric Resonator Antenna is designed on a rubber substrate to obtain large bandwidth characteristics. The DRA structure bends due to its flexibility and bendable characteristics, so it can be easily dressed in the wrist or other part of the body. The proposed DRA is designed to employ in the broadband range of 5.2GHz to 10.2GHz. The operating band has - 10dB impedance bandwidth is 64.9% (5.2-10.2GHz). The proposed bendable DRA has attained superior achievements in terms of return loss, gain, bandwidth and VSWR. The return loss of the proposed DRA is −48.06dB at 5.68GHz. The radiation pattern of the proposed flexible broadband DRA is explored.

articleTitle: IoT based Smart Baby Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the modern world, the growth of cell phones and the internet results in the recognition to Internet of Things (IoT). An example of such is the usage of cell phones by the working women to watch the baby cradle system. This system takes the at most steps to reduce the possibility of the baby cry when the sound is detected. Initially, when the baby cry sound is detected, the cradle starts swinging automatically. If the cry sound of the baby is not able to control over a particular time, now the baby needs the personal attention and it must be looked after immediately. It also checks whether the mattress within the cradle is wet or not. Also for the second condition the cameras module will capture the video surveillance of the baby. A small fan with a temperature sensor will also be placed to turn it on and off based on room temperature. All these information are gathered and transferred to the cloud, from there the data will be sent as an email to the parents phones with all parameters.

articleTitle: Binarization of Degraded Documents Using Linear Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the age of digitization, it is essential to convert the printed copy of the documents to the digital form. These documents are available through large number of sources - old books, old legal documents, medical-based notes, and safety-related reports. These documents are deteriorated and lead to low contrast. Several approaches have been discussed and designed to overcome the challenges encountered in the binarization of these documents. In this paper, proposed a various challenges encountered in the binarization process and also the method of linear regression in encountered for the removal of various degradation. Common challenges such as Ink bleed, uneven illumination, blurred character and contrast issues have been discussed. The proposed implementation uses linear regression which gives the flexibility to demonstrate the information extraction from the degraded historical documents. In this paper we have used DIBCO data sets from years (2016, 2013, 2012, 2011, 2010 and 2009).

articleTitle: Music Emotion Recommender System using Spectral Features-a Malayalam cine music deployment
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Songs tell a story with an interplay of different emotions. Hence, emotion analysis is widely deployed in today's music-based entertainment applications. Here, Malayalam cine music is analyzed for mood recommendation using spectral features and classification algorithms. Spectral features along with rhythm feature, tempo is extracted from the database created. The study attempts to compare the performance of models built with spectral features and rhythm feature(tempo). The extracted features are trained for classification using two algorithms- Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). Songs belonging to four categories namely- happy, calm, energetic and sad are considered here. The testing accuracy for simulation in case of neural networks is 80%. Performance of the models with a larger database is to be studied for future work.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Autonomous Driving System
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Self-driving cars have developed rapidly in the last decade, owing to advances in deep learning. The primary purpose of this research work is to provide an overview on the implementation of deep learning applications in autonomous driving systems. This research work has been initiated by analyzing the self-driving architectures that use deep learning and neural network combinations, as well as the deep reinforcement learning method These methods form the basis for self-driving scene perception, path planning, and algorithm behavior regulated by motion. Also, this research work analyzes how self-driving architecture is perceived, as well as path planning by implying that each module will be built using deep learning technologies and end-to-end systems. This permits all the self-driving directives to be mapped to the sensory data right away. Also, this research work studies the current challenges involved in designing the self-driving cars with AI-based designs. For example: safety standards, training data and computational hardware. The proposed research study also helps in determining the advantages and disadvantages of deep learning and AI techniques for developing autonomous driving systems.

articleTitle: Bit Error Rate Performance of Hybrid Interleaver in Turbo Codes
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: An Interleaver is a component or a system tool that is useful for saving processing time by rearranging the input bitstreams. The approach to design a hybrid interleaver is to cascade different interleavers such as the 3rd generation partnership project interleaver and block interleaver et cetera. As the number of bits increasing, the memory and time required for coding and decoding increases due to which some applications completely avoid using interleavers to save time resulting in high Bit error rates. This paper proposes a method to design a cascaded, two-stage, hybrid interleaver and also analyzes its bit error rate performance. The hybrid interleaver reduces coding and decoding times of turbo codes and maintains good bit error rate levels that are achieved in other interleavers such as the 3rd generation partnership project interleaver and block interleaver.

articleTitle: Implementation of Voice Based Hot-Cold Water Dispenser System Using Raspberry Pi 3
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In today's generation, our busy lives have been totally automated, which simplifies things and attracts people to automated systems, which minimize human labour, putting less effort, time, and errors due to human carelessness. This system is completely supported voice-based, and it employs a Raspberry Pi circuit. It also has an IR sensor, a voice app, a Bluetooth module, jars for holding water, pipes, and a motor. During this project, the voice app detects the person's speech and transmits the appropriate information to the Raspberry Pi 3, which determines whether the water requested by the person should be hot or cold. The raspberry pi uses the information from the IR sensor to determine whether or not the glass is put beneath the pipe. The device employs infrared sensors to detect the presence of a water glass, after which the IR sensor sends a signal to the Raspberry Pi, causing the motor to start and water to flow via the pipes from the real jar (hot/cold). If the glass is not placed, the sensor sends a signal to the motor, which prevents water from flowing through the pipe until the glass is placed. This approach is frequently utilized in reception, offices, homes, and other places where people want hot or cold water by just voicing a command.

articleTitle: BORS (Border Patrol Search) ROBOT by using Wireless Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Surveillance and monitoring is the method which humans can't perform manually every time and at every place. This has initiated the utilization of CCTV cameras for surveillance. Despite the advantages, CCTVs are not very efficient since it only has a fixed camera, which doesn't move much. The remote surveillance can be made easier by integrating the surveillance robot with CCTV camera. This type of robotic surveillance can be useful for all the federal, local and state services. Here, the proposed robotic model consists of a Wi-Fi module (ESP8266), robotic arm, wireless night vision IP camera and a metal detector sensor. The developed process is a simplest one, where the proposed model has connected the movements of the robot and arm with a Wi-Fi module and metal detector sensor to an Arduino. Furthermore, the Wi-Fi module and camera is connected to the phone by using an IP Protocol

articleTitle: Intelligent Garbage Monitoring System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this project, we introduce a waste management system that uses Internet of Things to monitoring garbage level in cans. Due to a lack of manpower, the local corporation does not collect reports on overflowing garbage cans. It could lead to unsanitary conditions in cities, putting people's health at risk. It can be reduce human intervention and also reduce the fuel consumption in waste collecting system. The Internet of Things could provide a solution to this conundrum. The Internet of Things (IoT) is a network of physical objects that are installed with software and sensors, as well as internet connectivity, to collect information and data. We may be able to create a smart garbage collector system by employing the Iot technologies. We might be able to create a smart garbage collector system using IoTThe system is intended to collect information and transfer it over a wifi module. The main goal of this design is to develop a system for monitoring garbage using data obtained from sensors.

articleTitle: Improving the Performance Efficiency of Village Pond Cleaner Using Arduino in the Basis of Bluetooth Controlled Process
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: As rapid technological developments are having an influence on human life in a number of ways due to quick advancements in many sectors; technology must also be implemented to make human existence easier to live. Water contamination is a major issue in wetlands and other bodies of water. Increased water contamination in the form of waste debris is affecting marine animal life and putting their lives in jeopardy. Similarly, some marine animals mistakenly consume surface waste debris as food, resulting in animal death. Attempting to make changes to reduce water contamination, this research work has developed a novel village pond cleaner model. A village pond cleaner is a system that removes waste debris from the surface of the water and disposes it safely in the water body. The pond cleaner in the village uses Bluetooth technology to remove drainage debris, plastic, and garbage from the pond. This machine has a cleaner mechanism that collects and removes waste and garbage from different water bodies. This also reduces the challenges faced in manually collecting debris. A computer can remove waste surface debris from water sources, resulting in less water contamination and, as a result, it reduces the death rate of marine animals. The proposed model is made up of a belt drive mechanism that lifts debris out of the water. This project would be used to remove surface water debris from ponds, lakes, and other water bodies.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Behaviour of Java–Based Movie Recommendation System using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Everyone like and enjoy watching movies. Movies have tremendous glamour and unique magic to educate, entertain, and influence the spectators to a great extent. The need is to take positive aspects from movies instead of the negative sides that may harm our society. In the current scenario, the people are more considerate on the rating points of any particular item that is available online or offline before investing money in it. Movies are also not unaffected by this fact of rating and recommendation policies. So, there is a need to implement a recommender system that can recommend a suitable movie to the viewers. In this perspective, this research work has implemented a movie recommendation system by considering the latent factor. This system is coded in Java programming language. The implemented application can be commercially used since it helps the viewers to select the movies of their own choice.

articleTitle: Development of Hour Ahead Demand Response Algorithm for Smart Home
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The optimization of energy consumption with a consequent cost reduction is one of the struggles in demand response under the Smart Grid environment. Under the DR paradigm, consumers are expected to change their consumption behavior by shifting appliances from on-peak period to off peak period. In this paper, Artificial Neural Network based Demand Response (DR) algorithm is proposed to predict the hour ahead price of the energy supplied from the utility. Time, day, holiday or working day, historical power demands and historical electricity costs are considered inputs and predicated price is the output of ANN. The hardware realization of DR environment is developed with Raspberry Pi. In which, Python based ANN is developed and different kinds of loads are interfaced with controller. Blynk app is utilized to provide information on demand level during off-peak, low-peak, and on-peak period.

articleTitle: Designing C Library for MODBUS-RTU to CANBUS and MODBUS-TCP IOT Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The IoT converters have made the communication between different devices working on different protocols very easy and convenient. This paper deals with designing a C library for two IOT Converters in which one device is working on MODBUS RTU to CANBUS protocol conversion and the other is working on MODBUS RTU TO MODBUS TCP/IP conversion, also implementing the same on the hardware. Creating a C library for establishing such communication involves socket programming which deals with setting up both wired and wireless communication. This paper covers the basic understanding of various serial communication protocols, their working and implementing the same at the hardware level. Here, this research work has laid down the flow of the converter diagram and also mentioned the algorithm for creating a C library. Working on the Modbus and Can protocols has proven beneficial given the capability of Modbus to support multiple devices on the same cable and the capability of CAN to replace the complex wiring system used in automobiles with an easy two-wire centralized bus system. In the end, this research work has discussed the application of these types of converters in real life and also compared them with any general IOT converter.

articleTitle: Implementation of Cyclic Redundancy Check in Data Recovery
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) technique can be widely used in data communication and storage devices in order to detect the sudden errors present in the data. The main motivation of this research was to detect the sudden, random or burst errors present in the transmission channels. This technique was very simple and easy to implement. It can be useful for the burst error detection and also to find the sequences of incorrect data present in the message signals. This technique was also good at detection of errors which were caused by the noise present in the transmission channels. The Conventional CRC Encoder and Decoder for 3 bits (101) and 4 bits (1100) was presented here. The proposed CRC Encoder and CRC Decoder were performed by using the binary division process and xor gate. Here, the generator or CRC polynomial or divisor was taken as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$x^{8}+x^{2}+x^{1}+1$</tex>. It can be written as 100000111 which can be referred to 9 bits of polynomial. This polynomial was kept as constant in the whole binary division process for all random data bits. The novelty of this proposed work was the implementation of both CRC Encoder and CRC Decoder for input random bits such as 5 bits (10101), 8 bits (11000011) and 10 bits (1100110011). The CRC Encoder, Decoder and Test Bench for all these random data bits were simulated, compared and verified by using Verilog coding in Xilinx ISE 14.7 tool. This proposed CRC technique was implemented in Data Recovery application. This technique can be extended to various increased data bit sizes and different generator polynomial expressions as a future scope of this research. In this work, the simulation results were limited up to 5,8 and 10 random data bits.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factors of Rural Home Stay Tourism Development based on Remote Sensing Assisted Operation Data Collection
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Since the reform and opening up, the development of China's tourism industry has come to an unstoppable end along with the development of China's economy. On the contrary, the development of tourism also has a great role in promoting China's national economy, so that the party and the country sit up and take notice. The traditional tourism resources based on sightseeing can no longer meet people's increasing demand for tourism. Therefore, new business forms and tourism modes such as vacation tourism, experience tourism and even the latest study tourism, family visiting tourism, red tourism and marriage seeking tourism are produced in the market. Remote sensing image classification technology is based on the geometric structure, spectrum and other information of ground objects to determine the position and category, and can obtain the changes and details of ground targets. This paper studies the combination and the model is tested with simulations.

articleTitle: Analysis of Radome Materials for Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Radomes are used for not only protection of antenna but also to prevent copying of circuits. Antenna gain and directivity is enhanced by the use of these structural features. Commonly used materials for fabrication of radomes are polyester, epoxies, cyanate ester etc. In this paper PTFE and silica are used with 1.632 GHz operating frequency. In this paper, radome is used to enclose a patch antenna. In this arrangement antenna is put over the dielectric base. The antenna and the ground plane are modelled as perfect electric conductors. The entire antenna arrangement is modelled for vacuum environment. Comparative analysis is done based on far-field radiation, electric potential distribution etc. further there is possibility of research for advanced materials in radome fabrication.

articleTitle: Design of Novel Patch Antenna using CST Software
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Many antennas have high accuracy and gain for early detection of breast cancer, however new patch antennas outperform other antennas. As a result, Jeans with a dielectric constant of 4.7 and a thickness of 1.6 mm are used. For best antenna output, the conducting type co-axial feeding method is used and this is a wearable type antenna, which is specially designed for 2.45 GHz applications. Using CST (Computer Simulation Technology), the patch antenna is simulated and the simulation results such as return loss (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S_{1,1}$</tex>), Directivity (D), Gain in dB VSWR are compared with the previously measured techniques.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of efficient adaptive equalizers for wireless communication application
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In Wireless Communication, equalizer is used to inverse the bending caused by a signal transmitted through a channel. Need of equalization is to decrease the effects of Inter Symbol Interference (ISI) without suppression of signal, but the noise power enhancement should be prevented with this reduction of ISI. Hence there is a requirement of less complex, more efficient Adaptive equalizer which suppresses the error and increases the efficiency in communication channel. In this paper the algorithm for the adaptive equalizer is proposed and performance is compared with Least Mean Square (LMS), Normalized Least Mean Square (NLMS) and Recursive Least Square (RLS) algorithm using 3 parameters; speed, power and area. The proposed Hybrid filter is efficient compared to LMS, NLMS and RLS in speed of execution and area utilization. The power consumption of this hybrid filter is higher than the LMS, NLMS and lesser than RLS.

articleTitle: Pre-Silicon Clock Validation for Server SoC
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Technology improvements have made it possible to move multi-millions of gate designs from big printed circuit boards to SoCs (System on Chip). Low cost for the design depending on the gate, low power consumption of the circuit, enhancing the circuit operation, easy implementation, reduced physical size, and improved design security are some of the benefits of SoC. The challenges of SoC design have expanded significantly as a result of rising complexities and reduced geometries. Because of the rising complexities of SoCs, verification efforts have increased significantly, which is necessary to meet time-to-market needs. Traditional simulation methods for SoC design verification are no longer sufficient for thorough system level verification, as most businesses have learned. The developed testbench infrastructure for SoC verification has been successfully implemented. This paper presents a more extensive demonstration of the System Verilog test bench for SoC verification, as well as verification methodologies that aid in the reduction of SoC verification time.

articleTitle: A Novel System for Real Time Drowsiness Warning and Engine Ignition Authorization using Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With the advancement of technology, there is huge progress in automotive industry. This paper proposes two automotive solutions to enhance safety and security features in vehicles. The first proposed solution is Real Time Driver Drowsiness Warning System implemented on Raspberry Pi 4B platform, with Raspbian operating system. This system is developed by applying transfer learning on CNN based pretrained model MobileNetV2. OpenCV libraries are used to detect drowsiness. The second proposed solution is authorized engine ignition using face recognition. Face recognition is achieved by using Caffe based detector and FaceNet algorithm. The recognized face of the user will act as key to enable engine ignition. Thus, this system will be able to reduce private vehicle theft. Driver drowsiness warning system is trained using MRL Eye dataset and achieved 98.75% accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Triple Band Slot Antenna for RF Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this paper, a tri-band patch antenna is designed for radiofrequency energy harvesting. To design the antenna, a simple pendulum shape structure is considered. The proposed antenna covers the band 1.2 GHz, 2GHz, and 2.5GHz. The bands considered for the harvesting are associated with many communication services including GSM (Global system for mobile communication), WLAN (wireless LAN), Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and ISM (Industrial, Scientific, and Medical). The proposed antenna achieves 5.53 dB gain at 2.5GHz with a quite good return loss of −27.25 dB. The partial ground structure is used to achieve the desired performance of bands. The outcome shows that the antenna is compatible to harvest the RF power from the required bands.

articleTitle: Modified FBDC Bypass Grid-Tied Inverter for Operating at Double The Switching Frequency
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The distributed power generation system offers many advantages in utilizing renewable energy resources for the generation of power. While integrating the system it is essential to maintain the quality of power that will be injected into the grid. The power quality can be improved by decreasing the total current harmonic distortion. The harmonic distortion can be reduced by designing a filter for the required standard, increasing the number of levels or by increasing the switching frequency. As switching frequency directly related to the switching stresses that a power device must be capable of it essential to switch to topologies or algorithm that are capable of working at lower switching frequency. This paper presents a modified full-bridge direct current bypass topology for improving the power quality while reducing the switching stress on the power devices. The inverter outputs a sine pulse width modulated signal that is double the operating frequency of the inverter. The diodes in the FBDC bypass inverter are replaced with IGBTs to give better efficiency. The topology presents a leakage current of 9 mA and the total harmonic distortion at the output of the inverter under no grid condition is 0.36%.

articleTitle: VLSI Implementation of Turbo Product Code
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Turbo product code (TPC) is a special type of parallel concatenation of convolution codes. The length of convolution code can be altered using TPC. They can be used as forward error correcting (FEC) codes. TPC using BCH codes are used for error correcting. In this paper we implement TPC encoder and decoder using BCH code. We also study and analyze the performance of TPC implemented using Hamming code and compare it with that of implementation of TPC using BCH codes. In this implementation, two or more component block codes can be used to construct TPCs. These block codes are mainly systematic linear block codes.

articleTitle: Multiband Microstrip Patch Antenna with circular slots for C-band and X-band applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Antenna always plays a predominant role in the field of communication for establishing a proper and efficient communication. In this paper, a micro strip patch antenna is designed to work at several satellite applications, C-band and X-band applications. In this paper, a circular slot-array antenna has been realized with 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>(where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{n}=2,3,4,5$</tex>) number of circular slots for the C-band and X-band applications. The parameters like return loss, Gain, E filed and H field and the Directivity of the proposed antenna are plotted by using Ansys HFFS. Rogers RT/duroid 5870(tm) is used as substrate material between ground and patch with dielectric constant 2.33 in order to maintain loss tangent 0.0012. The bandwidth provided by the proposed antenna is 82-528.9 MHz. The proposed antenna is operated with a return loss below −10 dB and the implementation of the circular slots into the design helps in achieving an enhanced return loss. The transmission lines are provided for the antenna excitation.

articleTitle: Application of Chebyshev Optimization in Political Education and Computer Education in Colleges
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the current Internet era, with the development of new media, computers have become an indispensable part of our lives. Similarly, in the teaching process of colleges and universities, many courses will involve the application of computers. At present, with the acceleration of informationization and electronization in all walks of life, basic courses of computer application are becoming more and more important in college teaching. In the original MOEA/D algorithm, the effect of punishment boundary crossing method is better than Chebyshev method, and most researchers have studied the boundary crossing method of punishment. In this paper, a super multi - objective optimization algorithm based on Chebyshev method decomposition is studied.

articleTitle: A Review on Malicious Software Detection using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Malware recognition is a significant factor in the security of the PC frameworks. Be that as it may, right now used traditional strategies can't detect exact malicious software detection. That is the reason the requirement for machine learning algorithm identification emerges. The motive for this exertion was to decide the best component extraction, highlight portrayal, furthermore, grouping strategies that outcome in the greatest exactness once utilized on the highest point of Cuckoo Sandbox. In particular, KNN, DT, SVM, Innocent Bayes and RF classifiers were assessed. This work presents suggested review techniques for machine learning constructed malicious [30], [31] characterization and identification, rules for its execution. Moreover, the review made be able to valuable as a base for additional exploration in the arena of malicious software investigation with AI techniques.

articleTitle: Deep CNN with Residual learning and Dilated Convolution for Image Denoising
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the field of digital image processing, filtering noise from the image to extract a high-quality image is an important pre-processing step for object detection, segmentation, tracking, etc. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has gained great attention in the domain of Image Denoising, with its flexible architecture. There are some challenges in using the deep CNNs for image denoising tasks like training the model and performance saturation when the depth of the network is increased. In the proposed model, two networks are connected parallelly to increase the width of the network rather than depth, and hence obtain more context information and make it less prone to performance saturation. Batch Normalization improves the performance of the network and mitigates the internal covariate shift problem. Dilated convolutions are used in the proposed model to extract more features by enlarging the receptive field. Residual learning is adopted to overcome exploding gradient and vanishing gradient problems. Experimental results have shown that our proposed model is more efficient than many existing filters.

articleTitle: Innovation of Chronic Disease Management Mode of Household Medical Devices based on the Perspective of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The increasing aging of the population and the changing spectrum of diseases have caused chronic diseases to become a major public health problem in our country. This article first cleans up the original data, removes single users and crawler users, and observes the distribution of purchase conversion rates over time through data visualization. The main feature of explicit feedback data is that users clearly express their preferences, and such preferences can be quantified. One of the most representative is the user's rating of the content, because the user knows that they are expressing their attitude. Therefore, this article applies big data analysis to chronic disease management.

articleTitle: Computer Monitoring System of Automated Warehouse based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Environmental monitoring needs to realize the effective monitoring of the environment, but also to achieve the control of related equipment. In the era of rapid development of science and technology, environmental protection and management need to adopt new information and communication technology to replace the traditional and backward monitoring methods. Under the background of high reliability in industrial production, programmable logic controller (PLC) emerged and gradually developed into a widely used industrial control device. In the industrial control system, PLC is often used as the main controller to complete the complex process control, as well as the real-time monitoring of the production status. This paper studies the stereo warehouse monitoring system based on PLC.

articleTitle: Digital Signal Processing of SAR Data for Surface Water Classification Using Remote Sensing Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A semi-automated approach was adopted for mapping the water spread area in the tanks and ponds using microwave remote sensing data from Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) C band imagery. The SAR data was preferred due to its distinctive imaging ability in all weather conditions. However, the images obtained from SAR contain noises because of the complexities of data acquisition, landscape conditions, etc. Hence there is a necessity to improve the pre and post processing of SAR data which involved orbital correction, reduction of thermal and noise, executing radiometric calibration, and terrain correction. In this study, the first Sentinel-1 C band SAR raw signals were transformed into an image by applying standard image compression techniques and the transformed image was further calibrated for removing the radiometric and geometric errors. Additionally, the speckle noise reduction was carried out with four filter techniques namely Median, Gamma Map, IDAN, and Lee. The analysis results show that the Lee filter reduced the speckle noises better than the other three filters without compromising with the image sharpness and contrast which resulted in producing better quality SAR images. The digital classification of enhanced SAR images using supervised algorithms was performed for identification of surface water body which has provided appreciable results. The threshold-based image classification technique has provided a better accuracy of 90% for the successful extraction of water bodies.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Image Enhancement Method in Deep Learning Image Recognition Scene
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: As the most important form of unstructured data in the era of big data, image has many advantages, such as large amount of information and easy to be accepted by everyone. In contrast to sound and text, images contain a lot of potentially rich information and are presented in the most direct way. At present, medical image is widely used in clinical examination, and has become an important means to assist doctors in diagnosis, disease evaluation and treatment. In recent decades, the development of computer technology has greatly improved the imaging speed and resolution of medical imaging equipment. However, the medical image is different from the ordinary image in daily life, which has the characteristics of multimodal, uncertainty and data fuzziness. This paper studies deep learning medical image recognition based on image enhancement.

articleTitle: Survival study on resource utilization and task scheduling in cloud
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Cloud computing provides different services to the registered users because users do not need to invest in computing infrastructure. Cloud infrastructure achieved enhanced resource service using various techniques depending on user requirements. Users have the potentiality in accessing several services provided by Cloud Infrastructure via the Internet. Cloud infrastructural resource scheduling allocated the arrival and service time for every resource with the cloud service provider. Cloud infrastructural resource optimization is the method of planning one or more resources for reducing the overall cost while attaining higher performance under given constraints. Several methods were designed for resource allocation, task scheduling in cloud infrastructure. But, some challenges like load instability and low quality of service were experienced by existing techniques due to different user requests in a heterogeneous environment. To overcome such issues, various resource allocations and task scheduling are reviewed.

articleTitle: Statistical Modeling of QoE metric for image transmission over weakly turbulent OWC channel
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With changes in data generation and dissemination patterns, the existing RF services suffer various limitations. The Optical Wireless Communications (OWC) due to its obvious benefits has become a strong candidate for delivery of multimedia in 5G and beyond networks. However, OWC's interaction with atmosphere leads to performance degradation due to phenomenon of atmospheric turbulence. In multimedia service delivery, the performance analysis is more comprehensively dealt with Quality of Experience (QoE) studies. Structure Similarity Index (SSIM) is one such metric. In this paper, variation of SSIM with respect to refractive index structure parameter C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and Rytov variance <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sigma_{\mathrm{R}}^{2}$</tex> for an image transmitted over a weakly turbulent channel is presented. The analytical models are developed for both the variations and compared to simulated values. Their convenience and accuracy are dealt in detail to provide deep insight into underlying phenomenon. It has been shown that for SSIM vs. C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> a fourth order polynomial satisfies as a good fit for analytical model whereas an exponential model suffices the same for SSIM vs. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sigma_{\mathrm{R}}^{2}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Digital Analysis Framework of Artistic Expression From the Perspective of Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The comprehensive material painting originated from the west in the 20th century, and then it was introduced into China and developed to a certain extent. Because the integrated material painting breaks the inherent framework of traditional painting, it can enable modern painters to create their own unique works, but also can stimulate the creative ability and passion of the painters. And to enrich the art form of painting, magnify the beauty of materials. This opens up a new space for the development of painting art, and makes the whole painting with vitality and vitality. Therefore, it is highly required to attach this importance to the study of aesthetic feeling and artistic expression of comprehensive materials in the application of painting art. This paper presents the essential VR model to construct the novel framework. The data mining is combined for the comprehensive evaluation.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Parallel Hybrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper presents modelling of the parallel hybrid electric drivetrain and its performance assessment. It is identified with the help of Simulink platform using MATLAB environment. The objective of the paper is to implement a control logic in order to improve the performance efficiency. The aim of this paper is to understand the necessity of new vehicle system by comparing the efficiency between the conventional vehicle and the hybrid vehicle. Simulation is carried out with the help of environmental protection agency (EPA) certified drive cycle inputs, with efficient control strategies. Efficiency of the system is compared with conventional vehicle. The simulation proves that the parallel hybrid electric vehicle fuel economy is improved by 32.8% with all modes taken into consideration.

articleTitle: Intruder Detection and Adaptive Irrigation System Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Agriculture plays a significant role in food production growth in India. In our region, agriculture relies on monsoons that are not an adequate source of water. Thus, in agriculture, irrigation is used. The Internet of Things (IoT) is an innovation in the advance of technology. In several areas, IOT plays a major role, one of which is farming, which in future will feed thousands of people on the planet. The aim of this paper is to solve this problem, the whole device is microcontrolled and can be run by wireless communication, so that irrigation times according to crop or soil condition do not need to be tackled. Soil parameters such as soil humidity, rainfall are measured, and pressurized sensors and sensed values are displayed on LCD. An irrigation control system was proposed for efficient water control and intruder detection. For the efficient operation of water and the identification of intruders, an irrigation control system was suggested. Soil Sensor parameters such as soil humidity, pH, humidity and sensor values are displayed on LCD. Informing the farmer via SMS and also updating the current condition in the field on the website. The farmer also has access to the server on the field, which would minimize power and time for people.

articleTitle: Design, Development and Control of a Planetary Rover using ROS
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Robotic rovers are mobile robots developed to perform challenging tasks such as astronaut assistance, autonomous traversal and sample retrieval in extra-terrestrial environments. Nowadays, there is an increasing interest in space exploration programs. Many developed and developing countries worldwide have succeeded in inter-planetary rover missions, including India's space agency ISRO. Planetary rover plays an essential and definitive role in every space exploration mission. Consequently, high technology rovers are necessary and the need of the hour. The authors took up this project to participate in the International Rover Challenge 2020 [1]. In this paper, a six-wheeled rover with a modified rocker-bogie suspension was developed with mobility in rough terrain as the primary goal. The rover consists of a 5 DoF robotic arm assembly which can provide enhanced capabilities. The rover consists of a space-frame aluminium chassis which provides rigidity. The electrical and electronic sub-system consists of off-the-shelf motor drivers, DC brushed motors, and linear actuators (for robotic arm) [2]. Two 10Ah Lithium Polymer batteries were used to power the complete system. The communication system provides wireless control of the rover up to 1 km from the base station. Nvidia Jetson Nano [3] is at the heart of the rover, which is essential to run a SLAM-based autonomous algorithm at the edge with low latency. The autonomous algorithm uses the wheel and visual odometry data collected from IMU, GPS, Lidar, and cameras to calculate the rover's optimum path.

articleTitle: Application of PLC in Manipulator Remote Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Manipulator can imitate the human hand and arm part of the behavior, and according to the inherent process to automatically grasp, carry or control related tools. It can replace human labor with high intensity to complete the mechanization and automation of manufacturing, and can be implemented in bad situations to ensure personal safety. Due to the rapid development of modern industrial manufacturing, manipulator is widely used in the global scope. In this paper, choose PLC to control the manipulator, complete the design of the automatic operating system, and achieve the manipulator up and down, left and right, rotation control. At the same time, other auxiliary components are needed, such as cylinder, sensor, solenoid valve, base and bracket.

articleTitle: Feature Recognition and Modeling of Historical and Cultural Documentaries from the perspective of International Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: As a carrier of “history” and “culture”, historical and cultural documentary not only shows rich cultural phenomena, but also contains profound cultural and spiritual connotations” “Cultural identity” shows the identity of a specific group to a certain culture. In this paper, the micro motion feature representation method of high resolution range change information is used to classify and recognize different human actions. Experimental results show that the average recognition accuracy of the proposed feature representation and recognition method for two types of 15 actions is more than 90%.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Application of Nonlinear Neutral Delay Differential Equations
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Neutral delay Integro differential equations are widely used in control theory, biological science, physics, chemistry, medicine, ecology and other fields. Many problems in science and engineering can be simulated and solved by nonlinear neutral delay Integro differential equations. However, the analytical solutions of most nonlinear neutral delay intemo-differential equations are very difficult to be solved, and the numerical method can make up for this deficiency. Therefore, it is very important to study the numerical method of nonlinear neutral delay integral - differential equation.

articleTitle: Visual Elements Mining in the Packaging Design of Children's Products based on OpenGL and SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Visual elements mining in the packaging design of children's products based on OpenGL and SVM is studied in this paper. Using the semantics of images to retrieve images based on people's habit of understanding and describing images is an ideal image retrieval method, hence, this paper selects the SVM as the theoretical basis for the study of the visual elements. For the implementation of the system, the OpenGL is the choice for the systematic optimization. The operator directly manipulates the robot, and records some key information and operation mode of the target by adjusting the position of the robot. After the comprehensive implementation of the system, the elements analysis for the packaging design is simulated.

articleTitle: Electrical Engineering Project Practice Based on the Horizontal Expansion of Intelligent Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Electrical engineering project practice based on the horizontal expansion of intelligent applications is studied in this paper. In the electrical automation control system, combined with intelligent control technology, system can automatically operate and then automatically control the entire production process, ensuring the efficient and automated operation of the electrical automatic control system. With this core perspective, this paper apply the intelligent model into the study, the project practice enhancement pipeline is designed for the overall analysis. The experimental results have shown the guiding performance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Tourism Big Data Analysis Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Since the advent of the Internet, the main parts of tourism information processing and transaction are processed by electronic means. Therefore, on the Internet, there will be many electronic traces of tourists related to tourism, including tourism decision-making, tourism process and tourism feedback. In recent years, many scholars in China have carried out some theoretical studies on the suitability of national park recreation and ecotourism, recreation planning and recreation management mechanism. However, the literature on the concept, classification and structural elements of recreation space is still insufficient. The traditional way of data collection and collation is far from meeting the requirements of big data. The urgent task is to upgrade and optimize the existing system and database.

articleTitle: Dual Axis Smart Solar Tracker Using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper presents the plan and pragmatic execution of a basic dynamic dual-axis sun powered tracker (DAST) to follow the sun's development by utilizing less segments and low-cost also. A dual-axis instrument is created to tilt the PV board by Servo motor and rotates using mechanical motor confronting the most noteworthy power of daylight detected using light dependent resistors sensors, which are fixed in the four edges of the frame. The DAST model was developed essentially and tried utilizing a real-time virtual instrument dependent on Dominate to decide its proficiency. Also, a correlation dependent on trial results between the energy delivered by the proposed savvy DAST and a fixed board shows that the brilliant DAS <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$T$</tex> produces 36.26% more energy contrasted with the fixed board. The proposed dynamic DAS T can be effortlessly carried out without having profound information about sun oriented following innovations and electronic designing.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Landscape Design and Image Recognition of Ornamental Grass Based on Ecological Aesthetics
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The concept of landscape architecture has a long history, which existed before the computer appeared, such as the Western Palace landscape architecture and Chinese classical landscape architecture. But in the past, landscape designers could only rely on paper and pen to complete their work, so the work efficiency was very low. Quickly and effectively classifing and recognizing images is of great significance. This paper proposes an improved multi-layer perceptron model and introduces dropout to solve the over fitting problem. Experimental results show that Parzen classifier can effectively classify images, and the algorithm has good generalization performance.

articleTitle: Bi-Level Pressure Ventilation Assistive Device for Pulmonary Ailments and Overlap Syndromes
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: People suffering from various respiratory ailments such as sleep apnea, asthma, Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disorder (COPD), requires a ventilation support system to improve their deteriorating health by providing sufficient amount of oxygenation which regularizes breathing pattern at night when the symptoms get extreme. Continuous Positive Airway Pressure systems often provides constant and continuous stream of pressurized air to the patient's airway which prevent apnea. Both BiPAP and CPAP machines can also be used to treat heart failure, which is a potential complication of COPD. To open the airways of the apnea patient during sleep, CPAP delivers single pressure of about 2 - 3 cmH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O, where BiPAP systems are designed with inhalation pressure and exhalation pressure controls for the treatment of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disorder and severe stage of apnea. The positive end expiratory pressure prevents the throat muscles from weakening and lowers obstructions. Throughout the night, airway pressure allows the patients to breathe easily and consistently. Exhaling against the incoming air can be challenging for patients during CPAP therapy with higher pressure powers as they have to push their breathing out. Some patients in BiPAP, may need CPAP. No existing device functions in both the modes. In these types of situations, the combination of a BiPAP system with a CPAP could be successful and become an alternative approach. This work aims at integration of CPAP and BiPAP mode of operation into a single machine by placing a pressure controls for inspiratory and expiratory positive pressure and a toggle switch to switch the mode of operation when required. Thus the system allows the patients to get more air in and out of their lungs.

articleTitle: Development of Music Theory Analytic Platform in Mobile Environment based on Mobile Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Music is not only an important part of culture, but also the spiritual and cultural heritage and wisdom crystallization of human beings. Music theory expresses human feelings and life in different countries, nationalities and times, and expresses people's feelings and wishes. Therefore, it is the most direct and effective way to spread Chinese voice, tell Chinese stories, carry forward Chinese spirit and show Chinese cultural confidence with music. This paper proposes a computing migration algorithm, selects a reasonable program decomposition granularity and designs a program decomposition algorithm to complete the construction of mobile computing model. The model can collect the trajectory data uploaded by the mobile terminal. After sorting the collected data, the analyst can call the algorithm interface in the system to analyze the trajectory data.

articleTitle: Application and Improvement of Low Temperature Heat Pump System with Air Replenishing and Enthalpy Increasing in New Energy Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With more and more attention paid to energy saving and environmental protection, the negative impact of coal-fired heating mode cannot meet the requirements of social sustainable development. Air source heat pump with its unique advantages has become one of the most widely used types of heat pump, but its application is constrained by climate conditions. It can be seen from the system principal analysis that the advantage of DC variable speed air supply enthalpy increasing heat pump system lies in the organic combination of DC variable speed and intermediate air supply enthalpy increasing technology, and effectively improving the adaptability of air source heat pump in low temperature operation.

articleTitle: Universal Daemonization and Programmable Object Interface for IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Internet of things (IoT) is a diverse and capable field which is very diverse and vast field which can be easily intertwined with other aspects of the modern technology. The world is becoming more and more connected to each other by objects and humans with each other by the use of internet. Nowadays the technology is able to provide information about its own operation and its activity. The implementation of IoT is not restricted by the geographical limits and environmental conditions. While there are many ways through which IoT can be implemented, there are prominently 6 ways IoT can be implemented wirelessly like Low powered wide area networks (LPWANs), Cellular networks including 3G, 4G, 5G, Mesh protocols, Bluetooth, Radio frequency Identification (RFID), Wireless fidelity and Zigbee makes it prominent. The interoperability of IoT to encapsulate hardware and software to create a global and local network provides IoT with its own infrastructure.
