Anti crawler is a passive operation for crawler, and it is a technology opposite to collecting web pages, so crawler must have the ability to deal with anti crawler.

articleTitle: Training deep neural networks for power control in Multiple input multiple output systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In wireless communication systems reliability can be achieved through spatial diversity and the data rate can be improved with spatial multiplexing. Multiple input multiple output systems otherwise known as MIMO systems achieves both. To improve the efficiency of MIMO systems, the available resources like power and spectrum should be optimally allocated among the users. Water filling algorithm is a classic approach for the same. This paper presents a version of the existing improved water filling technique approximated using deep learning technique in multi user systems inorder to obtain increased capacity and improved accuracy. Comparisons of already existing techniques, approximated with and without deep learning technique with proposed method is performed in single user and multi user based MIMO systems to obtain improved capacity.

articleTitle: The Theoretical Research of the Application Prospect of Intelligent Computer Aided Design in Print Creation
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Cahill, a famous German philosopher, once said, “Man is an animal that creates symbols. Through symbolic activities, man creates a cultural world, which is different from the animal world.” With the continuous development of printmaking art, the use of image symbols in printmaking is more obvious, and its importance is more prominent. To some extent, the image symbol is in an indispensable position in the development of printmaking. The times require printmaking to reflect its ideological and innovative, and rich image symbols endow printmaking with broader significance. This has provided more possibilities for the liberalization and diversification of print creation.

articleTitle: Reform of the Multi-mixed Data Model of College Physical Training Monitoring System under the Background of Information Sciences
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Reform of the multi-mixed data model of college physical training monitoring system under the background of information sciences is studied in this paper. We use a basic combination of event triggering and fixed step size to run large samples of the established experimental scenario and collect the comprehensive event and detection event data of the scenario run. For the integration of the information sciences, the fuzzy data flow optimization and abnormal information finding are both integrated. For the application scenarios, the physical training real-time tracking is studied. The platform implementation work is don based on the study of the overall performance.

articleTitle: Medical Records Management Using Cloud Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Medical Health Records are being used in healthcare services to reduce the issues and limitations of paper-based approaches, but their adoption has been slow due to high investment and storage files. Many hospitals have been using paper-based methodologies because they are unfamiliar with electronic medical systems. Confidential data, data sharing, and delegation of authority are mostly issues. Medical Records Management Implementation Using cloud technology in healthcare systems is now a distinctive trend. Because of benefits such as reduced price and efficiency, cutting-cloud cloud in order to reduce local storage, warehousing has become a common way of storing a high proportion of EHRs. Further, the proposed model has included an OTP authentication mechanism to the patient data, which gives a high level of patient data confidentiality that is not present in existing applications. Also, a different key will be generated for encryption and decryption each time when a user log in, which is more useful for protecting user's data from manipulators.

articleTitle: Innovation Mode of Intelligent Tracking and Positioning Service for Logistics Enterprises under the background of Data Tagging
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With the development of transportation, the time of modern logistics has been greatly shortened. Due to the immaturity of refrigeration and transportation management technology in China, the quality of fresh agricultural products can not be guaranteed. Therefore, it is an urgent need to improve the fresh-keeping technology, especially the real-time monitoring of the transportation process, timely find and track the source of problems. Considering that the sample data has the characteristics of noise, redundancy, heterogeneity and privacy, this paper designs a series of effective data marking techniques based on incentive mechanism.

articleTitle: Design and performance analysis of conventional and intelligent control for solar water pumping system
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper presents comparison analysis of P/PI/PD/PID controller with fuzzy logic controller (FLC) for solar water pumping system (SWPS). The conventional P/PI/PD/PID and FLC controller are compared in terms of rise and settling time, over and under shoot, error of steady-state and system stability at various motor speed and load torque. rise and settling time results shows that the FLC based system is better than conventional controller. Results also shows that the FLC based system is more stable and efficient. MATLAB/Simulink software is used for system simulation.

articleTitle: Design of .Net Online System for Accordion Music Guiding in Colleges in the Era of Multimedia Integration
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Since the beginning of the last century, accordion has experienced a journey from brilliant to plain. In the past decade, with the opening up and the prosperity and development of economy, China's exchanges with the outside world have become closer and closer. In this context, the development and construction of teaching materials need to be based on the actual needs of learners and make full use of modern information technology. Taking the paper teaching materials as the carrier, it can realize the integration and exchange of different learning resources, and finally realize the transformation and upgrading of the paper teaching materials. Deep learning is a new technology in the field of recognition, which can automatically learn the deep features of images and make accurate classification decisions, which brings new opportunities for better classification results of high-resolution remote sensing images.

articleTitle: The Application of Internet of Things and Online Video Recognition in the Cultivation of Intelligent Secretarial Talents
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In 2012, the Ministry of education listed secretarial science as a special undergraduate major, which is a qualitative leap in the development of higher Secretarial Education. The traditional training of secretarial talents is mainly oriented to enterprises, government organs and news media, so the training program is more inclined to Chinese major. In this paper, a frame sampling framework based on Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning is proposed, which is used to sample key frames in long video and improve the accuracy of video recognition. The method proposed in this paper can reduce the cost of computation and reduce the number of queries of non-target attacks by more than 28%.

articleTitle: Social Network Big Data Mining Method based on MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Online social network has gradually become an important medium for People's Daily communication and information sharing. Internet users can discuss hot news events, share pictures of daily life, comment on movies, books, food and so on in different social networks anytime and anywhere. The massive activity data left by a large number of Internet users in the social network is the online projection of users' real social relations, which contains huge data mining value. The characteristics of settlements similar to the real society are ubiquitous in social networks, and a large number of relational data with the characteristics of settlements can be defined by communities. Through the research of the potential information behind the community, we can dig out the transmission mode and change law of the information.

articleTitle: Transformation Technology of Computer Monitoring System of Hydropower Plant in Frontier Minority Areas
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The development of monitoring and control system in hydroelectric power plant can be started from the early manual control, which consists of a simple operation platform consisting of relays, operation buttons, signal lights and buzzers. The monitoring system can realize partial operation and monitoring of the unit, and the operation platform of electromechanical equipment is separated. This paper analyzes the threat of network communication in power plants and introduces the development status of network communication isolation technology at home and abroad. On this basis, through the demand analysis, this paper puts forward a design scheme of industrial network data monitoring and isolation device based on FPGA. The experimental results show that the designed industrial network data monitoring and isolation devices have high accuracy, security and transparency, and can indeed provide reliable guarantee for the network communication security of power plants.

articleTitle: Implementation of Collaborative Framework of Fashion Design and Intelligent Manufacturing based on Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Since the reform and opening up, China's consumption concept has changed from the traditional thrifty consumption concept to the dual consumption concept of material and spirit. Economic growth and the improvement of living standards give birth to the current concept of advanced consumption, and gradually replace the status of instant consumption in contemporary life consumption. In this paper, from the perspective of spatial integration, data modeling and virtual real mapping of intelligent manufacturing system and process are carried out. Firstly, this paper proposes the connotation and characteristics of intelligent manufacturing space, and reveals the logic of agent interaction and business collaboration in the intelligent manufacturing space. Then, the virtual reality mapping modeling method of multi-dimensional and multi-scale intelligent manufacturing space is studied.

articleTitle: Secured Natural Language Processing for Conversion of Unstructured Text Into Structured Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Natural language processing(NLP) enables the communication between humans and computers with the help of natural language. Most humans try to act immediately in case of an emergency. It will be in the form of a text message or voice message. This paper is mainly focused on such a situation and along with that more security is ensured to the message being sent. This can be developed further to form a private application that is free from vulnerabilities up to a limit. Sentiment analysis is performed on the text message to identify various information contained in the text and its importance. After checking the polarity, Named Entity Recognition(NER) helps in identifying the location of the person which increases the chance of the person being rescued. Messages are encrypted using Fernet(Symmetric Encryption) which is built on top of Advanced Encryption Standard(AES) in Cipher Block Chaining(CBC) mode and is transmitted to the receiver. Once it reaches the receiver, it is decrypted and converted into a text message. After syntax and semantic analysis, the conversion of unstructured data into a structured form is performed. NLP is such a strong process that can detect the presence of sensitive data.

articleTitle: A Smart AIS Based Portable Wireless Electric Charging Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The use of automobiles has grown dramatically, and so has the demand for petrol and diesel. As a result, electric cars are being introduced in our country. To charge electric vehicles (EVs) in public areas, only vehicles parked in designated spaces have the capacity to charge, while others do not; it is also not cost effective to offer separate charging sites at each parking slot. Hence, this research work has designed an autonomous robot-like mobile charger, which is portable and can charge electric vehicles (EVs) at different parking spaces. Vehicle charging can be done wirelessly in order to reduce the requirement of cables. In order to ensure the comfortability and autonomous charging of the battery, the inductive charging system has been developed. Due to the advantages of the non-contact method, manufacturers are working hard to commercialize this method.

articleTitle: A Low Cost implementation of Visitor management system for small organisation or enterprise
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: For any organisation or enterprise the entry of visitors is inevitable. It is of prime importance that how efficiently and effectively the visitors are managed in terms service to them. To provide satisfactory response to the visitors the host or reception must be smart and alert so as to cater the various requirements. Such personnel in the organisation would be working rigorously entire time in attending or responding to the visitors. It is the matter of fact that any unintentional human error or negligence can have negative impact on working structure of the host. In this paper a low cost micro controller based system has been developed for automatizing the students visiting to their department head for various purposes. Implementation results are also presented for typical activities involved in an Engineering Institution those are of routine in nature.

articleTitle: Logic Obfuscation Technique for Securing Test Pattern Generators
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: As the economic process of integrated circuit (IC) process proceeds, various supply chain components will copy ICs to introduce hardware Trojans, and overbuild ICs. A variety of hardware security studies have been conducted in order to prevent piracy, reverse engineering, and overbuilding through obfuscation. Obfuscating the design by arbitrarily inserting extra gates; solely an accurate key makes the design provide correct outputs. A hacker can decrypt the obfuscated design in an exceeding time rectilinear to the number of keys by observing the key values to the output. Nevertheless, these approaches provoke high overheads, and design obfuscation cannot give any security for the netlist of the third-party IP core (Intellectual Property). To avoid these vulnerabilities of hardware security approaches, this research work proposes a sensible logic obfuscation technique with low overheads to prevent a mortal from RE both the gate-level netlist and therefore the layout of IC and shield IC from piracy, and we then evolve techniques to mend this weakness and build obfuscation exponential within the range of inserted keys by designing the circuit through state diagrams in mentor graphics HDL designer tool.

articleTitle: Preliminary pulse and temperature testing
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The COVID-19 virus is currently the deadliest threat to mankind. The signs of the sickness include a change in the body temperature, a decrease in body oxygen levels, and a decrease in heart rate. Because of the pandemic crisis created by COVID-19, it has become essential to examine every individual's health so that it does not influence others in public areas as well as in their personal spaces. The primary goal of our project is to use the cloud to automate the temperature and pulse testing of every individual in public locations and preserve the database for future reference. To assist with the current scenario, we created a system that would automatically measure the individual's temperature using a temperature sensor and pulse using a pulse oximeter sensor without any human intervention. If the measured values are meeting essential threshold levels, the individual's hands are automatically sanitized and then they are allowed to enter inside public places.

articleTitle: Implementation of ALU using RTL to GDSII flow and on NEXYS 4 DDR FPGA board
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: An ALU is the major part of the CPU which performs various arithmetic and logical operations. It is one of the most frequently used modules in the processor. This paper presents the implementation of 8-bit ALU using RTL (Register transfer level) to GDSII (Graphic design system II) stream. The tools used for implementation are Cadence tools, Genus and Innovus. The technology node used for implementation is the 45nm technology node and 180nm technology node. The major focus of this paper is the design optimization in terms of area, delay and power as the industry demands the chips with high speed and low power. Further, the results of both 45nm and 180nm has been compared. The improvement by using 45nm technology in area is 89.59%, in delay is 43.23% and in power is 4.56%. In addition to that, the implementation of 4-bit ALU is done on the FPGA board. The board used is the NEXYS 4 DDR FPGA board.

articleTitle: Construction of Computer Aided Art Design System based on Image Aesthetic Measurement Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Art design is a broad field, which includes industrial design, architectural environment design, advertising design, web design, fashion design, animation design and other aspects. Computer Aided Design (CAD) course is an important basic and core course of design major, and also an important course of design performance course group. The purpose of computer-aided art design is to provide better service for the human needs of art design. At the same time, the humanization and intelligentization of art design are the ideal embodiment of service quality. At present, people's pursuit of artistic design level is more and more high, which puts forward new requirements and expectations for computer-aided artistic design.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Learning Platform (VLP) in the Network Guiding of Art
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Application of Virtual Learning Platform (VLP) in the network guiding of art is studied in this paper. For the design of the system, we firstly consider the network of edge attributes is called symbolic network, which plays an important role in the individual cluster analysis. Node attribute is an important feature of social network, which also plays a core fundamental role in individual aggregation. When modularity is introduced into symbolic network and node attributes are included in community structure analysis, the community structure characteristics of network can be analyzed more comprehensively. Hence, the VLP is proposed and applied to the network guiding. The system is implemented based on the Python and the performance is tested.

articleTitle: Logistic Regression Based Conveyor Control for Material Handling Process
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Increasing efficiency and reducing human errors are two crucial steps in automation for all sectors of industry. In industries, the job pieces of various size will be moved on the same belt. This must be separated in various locations within the manufacturing line. Once the products are produced, they must move automatically on to the conveyor belts. The work pieces of different sizes will be detected by the sensors that are stored in different locations. This system ensures the quality and quantity of the product being conveyed from one system to another. Conveyors that produce one type of object or product can monitor only one product at a time. If more products need to be monitored, a new system should be developed. Wireless control of the machine plays a very important role that's to scale back the manual work and save funds for the enterprise. It can reduce and conserve energy and power by automatically turning on and off the belt using sensors. The precision is often improved if these sensors are controlled by machine learning based algorithm. The proposed method offers accurate result to the belt. Test result shows that the energy saved is 13% higher than the conventional method.

articleTitle: Comparison and Analysis of Performance Using Different Classifiers for Classification of Motor Imagery EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Brain-Computer Interface system (BCIs) helps a person with severe motor impairment to control external devices without using the peripheral nervous system. The performance of the system defines the system's effectiveness. The major challenge in BCI to bring it out of the laboratory is the classification accuracy. To overcome this, a robust signal processing algorithm is required with an effective classifier system. In this paper, we have studied and analysed the performance of three different classifiers i.e., Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), Diaglinear and Mahalanobis distance classifier's accuracy for classification of left and right hand Motor Imagery (MI) Electroencephalograph (EEG) signals. It is observed that the performance of LDA and Mahalanobis are almost equal, however the Mahalanobis performs well for subject that doesn't perform well with the other two classifiers. This work can be further extended for classification of four different classes in future.

articleTitle: A Robo-Fuzzy Inference System for Iron based Sprouts Fortification
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Micronutrient malnutrition is a serious issue in rural-dominated developing nations, such as those in Asia and Africa, and millions are impacted. People are more vulnerable to concealed hunger and malnutrition as a result of their consumption of carbohydrate-rich foods that are low in micronutrients. Iron is regarded as the most important ingredient of a plant, which contains a variety of enzymes and pigments. These help plants in the generation of energy as well as the reduction of nitrate and sulphate. Multiple mobile Robots with wireless sensor networks utilizing Ad-hoc topology are deployed in this article to carry out field operations. The communication of multiple mobile robots with technologies enables to launch complex missions. Such an arrangement would allow the target achievement with greater accuracy and efficiency. Further, the idea of fuzzy logic is also proposed to achieve the desired goal of farming in terms of procedure and reap. From simulation result, it is shown that the fuzziness have provided additional edge towards the robotic movement.

articleTitle: Robot Path Planning using Modified Genetic Algorithm in EC2
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Path planning is one of the classical problem in the study of network technology in computer science, communications and operations research, geographic information system and robotics. As cloud is very popular in recent years and many organizations are switching to the cloud. This paper proposes the modified genetic algorithm to solve the problem of Robot path planning using EC2. The main purpose of path optimization is to determine the shortest path between the source node and the destination node. The proposed approach determines the shortest path using the fitness function proposed for the Genetic algorithm to perform collision free traversing of robots from its source to destination. The over all problem is solved using cloud computing platform. Here, this paper presents the concept of EC2. To validate the proposed work path length is taken as one of the important parameter. The results are comparatively better than the other relevant work and the same is validated and presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Application of Students' Cognitive Concept based on EEG Data Mining in Chinese English Translation Guiding
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The application of corpus in translation studies began in the mid-1980s, when it was mainly used as a tool for the study of linguistic contrast and translation criticism. Based on electronic texts and by means of computer statistics, corpus translation studies describe various translation phenomena in a wide range or in a specific range. Tourism translation refers to the translation practice of tourism activities and tourism. At the same time, it is a kind of cross - psychological, cross - cultural, cross - language, cross - regional, cross - time communication behavior. Therefore, tourism translation is no longer a simple process of language conversion, but the dissemination, exchange and acceptance of national cultural aesthetics and values. Tourism translation has been widely concerned by translators and tourists, and the research on tourism translation has also made qualitative progress. This paper uses the EEG data mining to construct the efficient system considering the cognitive data.

articleTitle: Nursery automation and monitoring in IoT using ThingView Free
publicationTitle: 2021 Second International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: IoT is an emerging technology in recent years. Using IoT, it is easy to build the application which makes human's life easier. It decreases the efforts of human physically and gives the pin-point values. Now-a-days, IoT has been implemented in every domain. One of the domains is nursery, where the plants are maintained in various weather conditions. The main objective of this paper is to develop an automated model which can also be monitored for the good growth of the plants in a nursery. Since various tiny plants are grown in a nursery, it is very important to monitor and maintain a good weather conditions which plays a key role. The parameters like humidity, temperature, and soil moisture are taken to monitor the plants. Whenever the temperature values are high, a fan is activated to maintain the temperature so that the plants will grow healthy. This doesn't involve a user to monitor the nursery all the time to ensure that all the plants are growing in a good condition with a good environment. This model is developed using Arduino AT Mega 328, ESP 8266 Wi-Fi module, and sensors like humidity, temperature, and soil moisture. The values predicted by these sensors can be viewed on ThingView Free application.
